quality_gates.note: Heuristic gates catch lighting blobs, seams, tilted courses and flat outputs. They do not prove the absence of windows or doors; visual review remains required.

composition.opening_note: Opening pixels are schematic placeholders strictly inside geometry masks. The 3D viewer cuts these regions and renders its existing door and window meshes.
